verdict.rationale: Kick documents a native per-account reconciliation workflow that compares Kick's transactions against bank or credit card statements. It explicitly aims for matching amounts and dates, no missing transactions and no duplicates, and reconciliation is a listed feature of the Basic plan. The docs do not show how matched, unmatched or duplicate items are surfaced in a review queue, so depth is unproven. Missing for 10: documented matched/unmatched/duplicate review views, per-item match/resolve workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can reconcile each bank account against the ledger with matched, unmatched, and duplicate transactions surfaced for review

citations.quote: Reconciliation verifies that the transactions Kick has on record for an account actually match what the bank has on record - same amounts, same dates, no missing transactions, no duplicates.
Reconciliation is the process of comparing your transactions in Kick against your actual bank or credit card statements to confirm everything is accounted for and accurate.
Basic — $40/mo — 1 entity, unlimited transactions, reconciliation, AI automation
